ICS: Students introduce themselves; briefly identify their discipline and educational preparation (how much preclinical and how much clinical at this point in their training).
A representative of each discipline interviews Pat (Note: Pat will not give feedback until completion of all interviews).
After the interviews, the group will review information and discuss treatment planning and concerns.

Students decide who will interview simulated patient (1 from each discipline); in what order and their time constraints (may depend on # of interviewers/disciplines). First at-bat, if present are Nurse Residents, followed by PT/Pharm, Dietetic Interns or PA (team decides) with Med student to go last. Allocate time equally.

After each discipline interview, group delineates on white board what information has been collected (what do we know now) and issues that have arisen. During this time (2-4 minutes) SP makes notes to guide subsequent feedback after all interviews completed.
How the way they were communicated with made them feel. Were questions and comments understandable, non-judgmental? Did SP feel heard and like a member of the team. Did team work well together?
If any counseling provided, did SP feel motivated and/or educated by approach to participate in own care and lifestyle changes?
